rows.name: Air Bladder
rows.description: If inflated, it holds enough air to sustain a Medium creature for 1 round or a Small creature for 2 rounds.

rows.name: Animal Glue
rows.description: Before you use animal glue, you must heat it until it liquefies. You normally apply it with a brush and hold the pieces together for a minute, at which point it is cooled and hardened. The glue is sufficient to coat 1 square foot of surface, or up to 40 smaller applications of approximately 2 square inches each.

rows.name: Area Map
rows.description: A geographically relevant map grants a user a +1 circumstance bonus on Survival checks made to navigate in the wilderness. It also can be used to grant the same bonus on Knowledge (dungeoneering) checks made to navigate underground.

rows.name: Bandolier
rows.description: Contains small loops or pouches for holding eight objects the size of a flask or small dagger. You can use the "retrieve a stored item" action to take an item from a bandolier.

rows.name: Banner (Simple)
rows.description: A simple banner with one field color and a simple insignia.

rows.name: Banner (Complex)
rows.description: A banner with two to four field colors and a complex insignia.

rows.name: Banner (Detailed)
rows.description: A detailed banner with four or more field colors and a very complex insignia.

rows.name: Bell Net
rows.description: Creatures attempting to access gear protected by a bell net must succeed at a DC 25 Sleight of Hand check to avoid chiming the bells. Hearing the chiming bells of a bell net requires a DC 0 Perception check. Because the many bells chime when you move, traveling with a bell net gives you a -2 penalty on Stealth checks.

rows.name: Blue Book
rows.description: By consulting the book for 1 hour, for the next 24 hours you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Knowledge (local), Bluff, and Diplomacy checks to gather or use information in that city. At the GM's discretion, you can use it in settlements near that city for a +1 bonus.

rows.name: Book of Letters
rows.description: It provides a +2 circumstance bonus on Diplomacy checks when dealing with city officials and a +2 circumstance bonus on Linguistics checks when creating forgeries.

rows.name: Breakaway Chains
rows.description: These masterwork chains are easy to break, even though they look like normal chains (Perception DC 25 to notice the difference). A DC 10 Strength check breaks them instantly.

rows.name: Camouflage Netting
rows.description: When you hide under the netting in the appropriate terrain, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus on Stealth checks as long as you remain immobile and prone.

rows.name: Candle Lamp
rows.description: A small lanternlike device with glass panels and a slot to hold a candle. It protects the candle from drafts and catches wax drippings. Provides the same light as a candle, but can be shuttered such that it only illuminates 1 to 3 adjacent squares. You can use a candle lamp to keep your hands warm.

rows.name: Cauldron (Mithral)
rows.description: Lighter than a standard cauldron and food rarely sticks to it.

rows.name: Copy of a Key
rows.description: An artisan can make a working copy of a key in an hour.

rows.name: Cypher Books
rows.description: A creature without access to the appropriate cypher book takes a -10 penalty on Linguistic checks made to decipher each page of a coded message.

rows.name: Ear Trumpet
rows.description: By holding this specially crafted ear trumpet to your ear and placing the other end against a door or wall, you reduce the DC penalty for listening through a door or wall by 5.

rows.name: Fake Footprint Shoes
rows.description: Each pair creates a specific type of footprint, such as tiger, orc, goblin, or ogre. When walking with these shoes, you may make a Survival check; the check result is the Survival DC for anyone trying to determine whether the tracks are what they appear to be.

rows.name: False Manacles
rows.description: A wearer who knows the location of the secret catch can open them as a standard action.

rows.name: Familiar Satchel
rows.description: Provides total cover to any Tiny or smaller creature contained within it.

rows.name: Filter Hood
rows.description: This snug leather hood has built-in goggles and a filtration tube containing sponges. A filter hood uses your helm slot and imposes a -2 penalty on hearing- and sight-based Perception checks. While the sponges are moist, the hood grants you a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against inhaled poisons and other airborne attacks that require you to breathe them. Moistening the sponges with water is a standard action. The sponges dry out after 1d4 x 10 minutes and should be thoroughly rinsed after each use.

rows.name: Gear Maintenance Kit
rows.description: This kit contains metal polish, a small file, a leather paring knife, conditioning oil for leather, two soft cloths, extra leather straps, a sewing needle, and a few buttons.

rows.name: Glue Paper
rows.description: If you apply glue paper to a window before you break it, the broken pieces stick to the glue rather than noisily falling to the ground.

rows.name: Grappling Arrow
rows.description: A small grappling hook designed to be tied to a silk rope and fired from a bow. When fired, it has a range increment of 30 feet.

rows.name: Grappling Bolt
rows.description: A small grappling hook designed to be tied to a silk rope and fired from a crossbow. When fired, it has a range increment of 30 feet.

rows.name: Heritage Book
rows.description: Consulting this book grants a +2 circumstance bonus on Knowledge (nobility) checks.

rows.name: Holy Text (Cheap)
rows.description: A small, light book with no illustrations, printed or written on thin paper, and with a cover made of canvas or thin leather.

rows.name: Holy Text (Typical)
rows.description: A typical holy text for an experienced adventuring priest. Durable, with a leather cover, chapter illustrations and quality paper.

rows.name: Holy Text (Expensive)
rows.description: The most expensive versions have detailed illustrations, gilded initials and border decorations, covers made of fine leather, wood, or even metal, and are often oversized and difficult to carry around.

rows.name: Journal
rows.description: a blank, lightweight book with an oilskin cover. It has 50 paper pages.

rows.name: Lamp (Common/Waterproof)
rows.description: Bright illumination (15'), shadowy illumination (30'), 6 hr./pint, holds enough air to burn underwater for 5 rounds before going dark.

rows.name: Lantern (Bullseye/Waterproof)
rows.description: Normal illumination (60'), plus 1 step (120'), 6 hr./pint, holds enough air to burn underwater for 5 rounds before going dark.

rows.name: Lantern (Hooded/Waterproof)
rows.description: Bright illumination (30'), shadowy illumination (60'), 6 hr./pint, holds enough air to burn underwater for 5 rounds before going dark.

rows.name: Perfume/Cologne
rows.description: Perfume or cologne may (at the GM's discretion) provide a +1 circumstance bonus on several Charisma-based skill checks.

rows.name: Shield Sconce
rows.description: This metal frame holds a torch and is designed to be strapped to the front of a light, heavy, or tower shield, allowing you to carry a torch without giving up your shield or occupying your weapon hand.

rows.name: Barbarian's Kit
rows.description: This kit includes a backpack, a belt pouch, a blanket, a flint and steel, an iron pot, rope, soap, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Bard's Kit
rows.description: This includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, a common musical instrument, a flint and steel, ink, an inkpen, an iron pot, a journal, a mess kit, a mirror, rope, soap, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Cavalier's Kit
rows.description: This includes animal feed (5 days), a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, a bit and bridle, a flint and steel, an iron pot, a mess kit, a riding saddle, rope, saddlebags, soap, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Chirurgeon's Kit
rows.description: This sturdy leather case straps to the waist or thigh, or can be slung over a shoulder. It consists of a leather pouch, a healer's kit, a bottle of strong brandy, a potion of cure light wounds, a vial of smelling salts, and 2 doses each of alchemist's kindness, antiplague, antitoxin, bloodblock, and soothe syrup.

rows.name: Chronicler's Kit
rows.description: This bundle contains a map case, two vials of ink, two inkpens, 10 sheets of paper, two blank journals, a pound of fine powder for drying ink, and a 20-foot measuring cord. The supplies usually suffice for chronicling a single expedition of not more than 2 months' duration.

rows.name: Cooking Kit
rows.description: This kit contains an iron pot, an iron skillet, a ladle, a skewer, a wooden cutting board, a cutting knife, an iron tripod for the pot, a packet of tinder, and a small selection of local or otherwise easy to find seasonings. You can attach the skewer to the tripod for roasting small game animals. All the component pieces (except the skillet) fit within the pot for easy storage and transport.

rows.name: Cleric's Kit
rows.description: This includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, candles (10), a cheap holy text, a flint and steel, an iron pot, a mess kit, rope, soap, a spell component pouch, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), a waterskin, and a wooden holy symbol.

rows.name: Dragonslayer's Kit
rows.description: Aimed more at hired blades than seasoned adventurers, this kit provides supplemental equipment for outfitting hirelings to hunt dragons. It includes a potion of cure moderate wounds, oil of bless weapon (1 application), a longspear, a backpack, three large sacks, a sunrod, a tower shield, and 5 vials of alchemist's fire. For hunting dragons that are immune to fire, the alchemist's fire can be replaced with acid at the time of purchase, for a savings of 50 gp.

rows.name: Druid's Kit
rows.description: This includes animal feed (5 days), a backpack, a belt pouch, a blanket, a flint and steel, holly, mistletoe, an iron pot, a mess kit, soap, a spell component pouch, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Dungeoneer's Kit (Common)
rows.description: This bundle of essential supplies for exploring ruins and abandoned cities includes two candles, chalk, a hammer and four pitons, 50 feet of hemp rope, a hooded lantern with 5 flasks of oil, two sacks, two torches, and four tindertwigs.

rows.name: Dungeoneer's Kit (Deluxe)
rows.description: A deluxe dungeoneering kit contains two candles, chalk, a hammer and four pitons, 50 feet of silk rope, two sacks, three sunrods, four tindertwigs, and an everburning torch.

rows.name: Entertainer's Kit
rows.description: This kit includes juggling balls, colored handkerchiefs, playing cards, clownish makeup, and other simple props for stage magicians and other street entertainers.

rows.name: Fighter's Kit
rows.description: This kit includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, a flint and steel, an iron pot, a mess kit, rope, soap, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Fishing Kit
rows.description: This kit includes a simple fishing pole and a small box that contains fishing tackle (hooks, lines, sinkers, floats, and lures).

rows.name: Gambler's Kit (Cheating)
rows.description: This small, tightly packed suitcase holds decks of cards, a betting wheel, numbered cloths, colored wooden chips, and a wide variety of other sorts of specialized equipment necessary for many different games of chance. A cheating gambler's kit is very similar, except its cards are marked and its games are rigged, giving a knowledgeable user a +4 circumstance bonus on Profession (gambler) checks when using these materials. A DC 25 Perception or DC 20 Profession (gambler) check exposes the ruse.

rows.name: Gambler's Kit (Common)
rows.description: This small, tightly packed suitcase holds decks of cards, a betting wheel, numbered cloths, colored wooden chips, and a wide variety of other sorts of specialized equipment necessary for many different games of chance.

rows.name: Gunslinger's Kit
rows.description: This includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, a flint and steel, a gunsmith's kit, an iron pot, a mess kit, a powder horn, rope, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Inquisitor's Kit
rows.description: This kit includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, candles (10), a cheap holy text, a flint and steel, an iron pot, manacles, a mess kit, rope, soap, a spell component pouch, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), a waterskin, and a wooden holy symbol.

rows.name: Magus's Kit
rows.description: This includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, a flint and steel, ink, an inkpen, an iron pot, a mess kit, rope, soap, a spell component pouch, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Monk's Kit
rows.description: This kit includes a backpack, a belt pouch, a blanket, rope, soap, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Oracle's Kit
rows.description: This kit includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, candles (10), a flint and steel, an iron pot, mess kit, rope, soap, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Paladin's Kit
rows.description: This kit includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, a cheap holy text, a flint and steel, an iron pot, a mess kit, rope, soap, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), a waterskin, and a wooden holy symbol.

rows.name: Pathfinder's Kit
rows.description: This kit consists of a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, a clay mug, a dagger, two fishhooks, a flint and steel, a sewing needle, a signal whistle, 50 feet of string, 50 feet of thread, a waterskin, a week's worth of trail rations, and a whetstone. For Small creatures, the weight of a Pathfinder's kit is 7-1/2 pounds. Leaving the bedroll and rations at camp or on a mount reduces the weight by 12 pounds for Medium creatures and by 3 pounds for Small creatures.

rows.name: Ranger's Kit
rows.description: This includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, a flint and steel, iron pot, mess kit, rope, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Riding Kit (Common)
rows.description: This kit includes a bit and bridle, a saddle, a saddle blanket, saddlebags, and 2 days' worth of feed for a mount. The weight can be lightened 10 pounds by discarding the feed.

rows.name: Riding Kit (Exotic Mount)
rows.description: This kit includes a bit and bridle, a saddle, a saddle blanket, saddlebags, and 2 days' worth of feed for a mount. The weight can be lightened 10 pounds by discarding the feed.

rows.name: Rogue's Kit
rows.description: This kit includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, caltrops, chalk (10), a flint and steel, a grappling hook, an iron pot, a mess kit, a mirror, pitons (10), rope, soap, thieves' tools, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Scrivener's Kit
rows.description: This soft leather case contains a vial for holding ink, an ink pen, spare pen nibs, a small container of pigment for making ink, a tiny knife for cutting quills into pens, a blotter, and a small ruler.

rows.name: Sorcerer's Kit
rows.description: This kit includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, a flint and steel, an iron pot, a mess kit, soap, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Spelunking Kit
rows.description: This kit holds equipment for exploring underground, consisting of a lantern with 4 flasks of oil, a hammer and 8 pitons, 100 feet of silk rope, a grappling hook, and a climber's kit.

rows.name: Summoner's Kit
rows.description: This kit includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, a flint and steel, an iron pot, a mess kit, soap, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Troll Slayer's Kit
rows.description: This kit includes 1 vial of alchemist's fire, 1 flask of acid, 10 torches, one tindertwig, and 5 flasks of oil.

rows.name: Undead Slayer's Kit
rows.description: This kit includes a wooden holy symbol, a necklace of garlic bulbs, a hammer, a wooden stake, 2 flasks of holy water, one sunrod, a potion of lesser restoration, and a potion of protection from evil.

rows.name: Witch's Kit
rows.description: This kit includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, candles (10), chalk (10), a flint and steel, ink, an inkpen, an iron pot, a mess kit, soap, a spell component pouch, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Wizard's Kit
rows.description: This kit includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, a flint and steel, ink, an inkpen, an iron pot, a mess kit, soap, a spell component pouch, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.

rows.name: Fire Ward Gel
rows.description: Gain fire resistance 5 until 20 points of fire damage have been absorbed.

rows.name: Frost Ward Gel
rows.description: Gain cold resistance 5 until 20 points of cold damage have been absorbed.

rows.name: Meditation Tea
rows.description: For ten minutes after drinking gain a +2 alchemical bonus against mind affecting effects.

rows.name: Padzahr
rows.description: Resting 1 hour after drinking a vial heals 1 point of CON damage.

rows.name: Soul Stimulant
rows.description: Negates negative level penalties for 12 hours.

rows.name: Troll Oil
rows.description: For 1 hour, automatically stabilize when reduced to negative hit points, gain 50% chance to end any bleed effect.

rows.name: Twitch Tonic
rows.description: Gain +2 alchemical bonus against sleep, paralysis and the staggered condition for 1 hour.

rows.name: Vermin Repellent
rows.description: Swarms of vermin smaller than Tiny must make a successful DC 15 Fortitude saving throwin order to enter your square.

rows.name: Wismuth Salix
rows.description: Gain +2 alchemical bonus against nauseated or sickened condition for 1 hour.

rows.name: Liquid Blade
rows.description: Lasts for 10 minutes. Fragile.

rows.name: Flame Fountain Firework
rows.description: Attacks are melee touch attacks. Lasts 1 min. Move action to light fuse.

rows.name: Banshee Ballerina (Firework)
rows.description: Any creatures within 5 feet of the noise are effectively deafened while they remain in the area. Burns for 1d4+1 rounds.

rows.name: Bottled Lightning
rows.description: Any creature in a line between you and the target (including the target) takes 1 point of sonic damage.

rows.name: Burst Jar
rows.description: One round later on the turn the jar was thrown, the target takes 1 point of sonic damage, is deafened for 1d4 rounds, and must make a DC 12 Fortitude save or be stunned for 1 round. Creatures within 5 feet of the explosion take 1 point of sonic damage.

rows.name: Fuse Grenade
rows.description: Lighting the fuse is a move action; 1d3 rounds later the grenade explodes, dealing 2d6 points of bludgeoning damage and 1d6 points of fire damage in a 10-foot-radius burst (Reflex DC 15 halves).

rows.name: Ghast Retch (Flask)
rows.description: The target is nauseated for 1 round and sickened for 3 rounds after that. A successful DC 12 Fortitude save prevents the nauseated condition, but not the sickened condition. Creatures within 5 feet of where the flank hits are sickened for 1 round

rows.name: Itching Powder
rows.description: Anyone standing on the square of impact must succeed at a DC 12 Fortitude save to resist the powder, while those in adjacent squares must make a DC 8 Fortitude save. Creatures that fail the save take a -2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks until they wash the powder off.

rows.name: Keros Oil (Flask)
rows.description: Taking a mouthful from the bottle is a standard action.

rows.name: Paper Candle (Firework)
rows.description: Anyone in the same square when it explodes must make a DC 15 Fortitude save or be dazzled for 1d4 rounds.

rows.name: Pellet Grenade (Iron)
rows.description: Lighting the fuse is a move action; 1d3 rounds later the grenade explodes, dealing 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage, 1d6 points of piercing damage and 1d6 points of fire damage in a 10-foot-radius burst (Reflex DC 15 halves).

rows.name: Pellet Grenade (Silver)
rows.description: Lighting the fuse is a move action; 1d3 rounds later the grenade explodes, dealing 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage, 1d6 points of piercing damage and 1d6 points of fire damage in a 10-foot-radius burst (Reflex DC 15 halves).

rows.name: Pellet Grenade (Cold Iron)
rows.description: Lighting the fuse is a move action; 1d3 rounds later the grenade explodes, dealing 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage, 1d6 points of piercing damage and 1d6 points of fire damage in a 10-foot-radius burst (Reflex DC 15 halves).

rows.name: Pellet Grenade (Adamantine)
rows.description: Lighting the fuse is a move action; 1d3 rounds later the grenade explodes, dealing 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage, 1d6 points of piercing damage and 1d6 points of fire damage in a 10-foot-radius burst (Reflex DC 15 halves).

rows.name: Shard Gel (Flask)
rows.description: The target's square and each square adjacent to it are covered in shards that function like caltrops for 5 rounds

rows.name: Skyrocket (Firework)
rows.description: Takes flight one round after being lit at a speed of 90 ft for 1d6 rounds. Damage is a 10-ft-radius burst. Anyone who takes damage from the explosion is either blinded or deafened (50% chance of either) for 1 round.

rows.name: Sneezing Powder
rows.description: Causes uncontrollable sneezing for 1d4+1 rounds. Anyone standing in the square of impact must succeed at a DC 12 Fortitude save to resist the powder, while those in adjacent squares must make DC 8 Fortitude saves. Affected creatures must make a DC 10 Fortitude save every round for the duration or be staggered until their next turn.

rows.name: Star Candle (Firework)
rows.description: Launches every round for 4 rounds after being lit. Deals 1 point of nonlethal damage and 1 point of fire damage; on a critical hit, the target is also blinded for 1 round.

rows.name: Starfountain (Firework)
rows.description: Indoors or in a closed area, the ricocheting fireworks deal damage each round in a 20-foot-radius spread (Reflex DC 15 halves). Creatures who fail their save are blinded for 1d4 rounds and deafened for 1 hour.

rows.name: Tangleburn Bag
rows.description: An entangled creature takes a -2 penalty on attack rolls and a -4 penalty to Dexterity and must make a DC 15 Reflex save or be glued to the floor, unable to move. A direct hit on a creature deals 1d6 points of fire damage, and the creature must make a DC 20 Reflex save or catch on fire.

rows.name: Poison (Indigo Dreams)
rows.description: Ingested; Fort DC 13; Onset 10 min; Freq 1 min (6); Effect 1d3 Wis dmg; Cure 2 consecutive saves

rows.name: Poison (Swampseer Poison)
rows.description: Ingested; Fort DC 11; Onset 10 min; Freq 1 min (4); Effect 1d3 Wis and 1 Int dmg; Cure 1 save

rows.name: Poison (Azure Lily Pollen)
rows.description: Inhaled; Fort DC 15; Freq 1 min (2); Effect nauseated 1 min, paralyzed 2d4 hours; Cure 1 save

rows.name: Catskin Leather
rows.description: takes only half normal damage from falling.

rows.name: Armor of Arrow Attraction
rows.description: The wearer takes a -15 penalty to AC against ranged weapons.

rows.name: Armor of Rage
rows.description: All unfriendly creatures within 300 feet gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls against the wearer.

rows.name: Flight Arrows (20)
rows.description: A flight arrow's range increment is 20 feet greater with longbows, 10 feet greater with shortbows. They deal damage as if one size category smaller.

rows.name: Buckler Gun
rows.description: Misfire 1 (5 ft.)

rows.name: Pepperbox
rows.description: Misfire 1-2 (5 ft.)

rows.name: Pistol
rows.description: Misfire 1 (5 ft)

rows.name: Pistol (Coat)
rows.description: Misfire 1 (5 ft.)

rows.name: Pistol (Dagger)
rows.description: Misfire 1 (5 ft.)

rows.name: Pistol (Double-Barreled)
rows.description: Misfire 1-2 (5 ft.)

rows.name: Pistol (Dragon)
rows.description: Misfire 1-2 (5 ft.); Scatter 15' cone

rows.name: Pistol (Sword Cane)
rows.description: Misfire 1 (5 ft.)

rows.name: Blunderbuss
rows.description: Misfire 1-2 (10 ft); Scatter 15' cone

rows.name: Culverin
rows.description: Misfire 1 (10 ft.); Firing a culverin without support (such as a wall, a window, or a stand) imparts a -4 penalty on the attack rolls, and the wielder is knocked prone. A culverin uses 4 doses of black powder and grapeshot.

rows.name: Double Hackbut
rows.description: Misfire 1-2 (5 ft.)

rows.name: Fire Lance
rows.description: Misfire 1-4 (5 ft.)

rows.name: Musket
rows.description: Misfire 1-2 (5 ft)

rows.name: Musket (Axe)
rows.description: Misfire 1-2 (5 ft.)

rows.name: Musket (Double-Barreled)
rows.description: Misfire 1-3 (5 ft.)

rows.name: Musket (Warhammer)
rows.description: Misfire 1-2 (5 ft.)

rows.name: Revolver
rows.description: Misfire 1

rows.name: Rifle
rows.description: Misfire 1

rows.name: Rifle (Pepperbox)
rows.description: Misfire 1-2

rows.name: Shotgun
rows.description: Misfire 1-2; Scatter 30' cone

rows.name: Shotgun (Double-Barreled)
rows.description: Misfire 1-2; Scatter 30' cone

rows.name: Ornery Pistol
rows.description: Takes a shot at any creature the wielder or an ally uses diplomacy against.

rows.name: Unstable Musket
rows.description: Misfire on 1-5 (5 ft)

rows.name: Berserking Sword
rows.description: Whenever used in battle the wielder goes berserk as per Barbarian's Rage ability.

rows.name: Biting Battleaxe
rows.description: When using Great Cleave feat, the wielder makes an additional attack against a random adjacent creature, always counting self as adjacent.

rows.name: Heavy Hammer
rows.description: Must be used as primary weapon

rows.name: Mace of Blood
rows.description: Must be coated in blood every day. Owner must make a DC 13 Will save every day or become Chaotic Evil.

rows.name: Net of Snaring
rows.description: Can only be thrown underwater. If thrown on land, targets creature that threw it.

rows.name: Unwieldy Glaive
rows.description: When attack of opportunity is attempted, wielder takes a 2 penalty to AC and on attack rolls until the end of its next turn

rows.name: Demon Prince Armor Claw Attack
rows.description: Those struck by the claws must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save or be affected as per the spell contagion.

rows.name: Hammer of Thunderbolts (Major Form)
rows.description: On hit when thrown, all creatures within 90 ft stunned 1 round (Fort DC 15 negates)

rows.key: Ring of Rat Fangs Bite Attack
rows.name: Ring of Rat Fangs Bite Attack
Cursed Backbiter Spear
rows.description: When attack roll is natural 1, deals damage to wielder.

rows.name: Deadly Returns Throwing Axe
rows.description: Only returns when wielder misses target. On return, attacks wielder.

rows.name: Arrowbreak Bow
rows.description: Arrows are always broken on either a hit or a miss.

rows.name: Nearfiring Bow
rows.description: Takes an additional 4 penalty on critical confirmation rolls when firing beyond the first range increment.

rows.name: Amulet of Inescapable Location
rows.description: Gives the wearer -10 penalty on all saves against divination spells.

rows.name: Belt of Weakness
rows.description: When the wearer rolls a natural 1 on any Fortitude save, the belt constricts, dealing 2d8 points of damage.

rows.name: Boots of Dancing
rows.description: Impede movement, making the wearer behave as per Irresistable Dance.

rows.name: Cape of Anchoring
rows.description: Affects wearer as per Dimensional Anchor spell.

rows.name: Drums of Lethargy
rows.description: Affects all creatures as per the Slow spell.

rows.name: Eyes of Blindness
rows.description: Wearer becomes blinded

rows.name: Flask of Curses
rows.description: When the flask is first unstoppered, all creatures within 30 feet must make a DC 17 Will save or be cursed, taking a 2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks until a remove curse spell is cast upon them.

rows.name: Gauntlets of Fumbling
rows.description: 50%% chance each round of dropping anything held in either hand.

rows.name: Helm of Opposite Alignment
rows.description: Changes alignment of the wearer.

rows.name: Incense of Obsession
rows.description: User must use spells at every opportunity.

rows.name: Necklace of Strangulation
rows.description: Immediately tightens, dealing 6 points of damage per round.

rows.name: Periapt of Foul Rotting
rows.description: After 24 hours, owner contracts a rotting disease that drains 1 point of Dex, Con and Cha every week

rows.name: Petrifying Cloak
rows.description: Wearer must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save or be instantly petrified.

rows.name: Poisonous Cloak
rows.description: The wearer takes 4d6 points of CON damage unless she succeeds on a DC 28 Fortitude save.

rows.name: Potion of Poison
rows.description: 1d3 Con per round for 6 rounds, DC 14 Fort negates.

rows.name: Ring of Clumsiness
rows.description: Acts as Ring of Featherfall

rows.name: Ring of Lifebleed
rows.description: Each time wearer is hit, he takes and additional 1d4 point of damage.

rows.name: Robe of Vermin
rows.description: Must make concentration check (DC 20 + spell level) or lose the spell when casting.

rows.name: Scarab of Death
rows.description: DC 25 Reflex save or die, or take 3d6 points of damage.

rows.name: Ring of Sacred Mistletoe

rows.name: Ring of Strength Sapping
rows.description: On successful unarmed attack, target takes 1d4 STR damage (DC 20 Fort negates) conferring +2 STR bonus to wearer.

rows.name: Ring of Tactical Precision
rows.description: May be imbued with a teamwork feat for 24 hours.

rows.name: Ring of Transposition
rows.description: Can be bound to any other mundane ring, allowing the wearers of both rings to trade places within 800 ft.

rows.name: Ring of the Ecclesiarch
rows.description: Doubles number of followers you can attract.

rows.name: Ring of the Grasping Grave
rows.description: On successful melee touch attack, undead creature cannot be healed or aided by negative energy for 1d4 rounds.

rows.name: Ring of the Troglodyte
rows.description: All creatures within 10-ft radius sickened for 1 round (DC 14 Fort negates).

rows.name: Scholar's Ring
rows.description: Grants complete understanding as per Comprehend Languages

rows.name: Spiritualist Rings
rows.description: Wearer's weapons gain Ghost Touch ability.; Wearer gains +4 sacred bonus against negative energy effects.; Wearer gains +4 profane bonus against positive energy effects.; Wearer must pick either a sacred or profane bonus against negative or positive energy effects.

rows.name: Steelhand Circle
rows.description: Wearer ignores 5 points of hardness. 1/day wearer can negate (50% chance) a critical hit or sneak attack.

rows.name: Rod (Conduit)
rows.description: Gain electricity resistance 5, +1 effective caster level when casting any spell with electricity descriptor.

rows.name: Belt of Teeth
rows.description: Allows wearer to make attack of opportunity using bite attack.

rows.name: Belt of Thunderous Charging
rows.description: When the wearer makes a charge attack, her melee weapons and natural weapons deal damage as if they were one size category larger than they actually are.

rows.name: Belt of Tumbling
rows.description: The belt's wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks made to move through a threatened square or through an enemy's space.

rows.name: Belt of the Weasel
rows.description: Wearer is able to move at half normal speed while prone.

rows.name: Bladed Belt
rows.description: On command, the belt's wearer can transform the belt into a single masterwork slashing and/or piercing melee weapon of her choice.

rows.name: Blinkback Belt
rows.description: When the wearer draws a weapon attached to this belt and throws it before the end of her next turn, the weapon teleports back to its strap or sheath immediately after the attack is resolved.

rows.name: Cord of Stubborn Resolve
rows.description: Any effect which would cause the wearer to become fatigued deals an additional 1d6 points of nonlethal damage instead. Any effect that would cause exhaustion likewise causes 1d6 points of nonlethal damage, and leaves the wearer fatigued instead of exhausted.

rows.name: Elemental Earth Belt
rows.description: The wearer is immune to effects that would push, pull, or forcefully move the wearer.; once per day on command, the wearer can take the form of a Large earth elemental, and though subject to the elemental body III spell.

rows.name: Equestrian Belt
rows.description: The belt's wearer automatically succeeds at any check to guide with the knees, stay in the saddle, fight with a combat-trained mount, control a mount in battle, or make a fast mount or dismount, as long as the belt's wearer is wearing medium, light, or no armor.

rows.name: Gorgon Belt
rows.description: Ignore difficult terrain while charging or making an overrun, bull rush, or trample attempt.; Once per day on command, its wearer can spew a 60-foot cone of poisonous green gas as a breath weapon. Any creature caught in the area of the gas can attempt a DC 18 saving throw or be paralyzed for 1d4 rounds. At the end of its turn, a creature petrified by this breath weapon can attempt a new save to end the paralysis effect.

rows.name: Merform Belt
rows.description: Once per day, the wearer of this belt can command it to transform her into the form of a merfolk.

rows.name: Monkey Belt
rows.description: The wearer does not lose his Dexterity bonus to AC while climbing, and does not take a -5 penalty on Climb checks when climbing at half his speed.; As a swift action the wearer can command the belt to transform into a prehensile tail that can make unarmed attacks and hold or manipulate objects.

rows.name: Monkey Belt (Greater)
rows.description: The wearer does not lose his Dexterity bonus to AC while climbing, and does not take a -5 penalty on Climb checks when climbing at half his speed.; As a swift action the wearer can command the belt to transform into a prehensile tail that can make unarmed attacks and hold or manipulate objects.

rows.name: Plague Rat Belt
rows.description: As an immediate action three times per day, the wearer can call upon the belt to reroll a saving throw made to resist a disease or poison.

rows.name: Plague Rat Belt (Greater)
rows.description: As an immediate action three times per day, the wearer can call upon the belt to reroll a saving throw made to resist a disease or poison.

rows.name: Sash of Flowing Water
rows.description: Attempt to deflect a successful melee attack with an immediate action if have a hand free.

rows.name: Security Belt
rows.description: Increases the DC of Sleight of Hand checks made against the wearer by 5. The wearer also gets a +5 bonus to CMD against the steal maneuver.; Once per day on command, the wearer can shrink a single item of up to 10 cubic feet into a tiny cloth duplicate. Restoring a shrunk item is a move action.

rows.name: Serpent Belt
rows.description: +4 bonus to all poisons; Once per day the belt can be animated as a venomous snake or constrictor snake

rows.name: Serpent Belt (Greater)
rows.description: +4 bonus to all poisons; Once per day the belt can be animated as a venomous snake or constrictor snake. Speak second command to grant template to snake.

rows.name: Shadowform Belt
rows.description: As a swift action, its wearer can become incorporeal for up to 10 rounds per day.

rows.name: Gunman's Duster
rows.description: +1 to bonus granted by Gunslinger's Dodge deed; Wearer may use Gunslinger's Dodge deed once per day.

rows.name: Otherworldly Kimono
rows.description: Once per day, the wearer can capture a single creature within 60 feet within the kimono (no save).

rows.name: Resplendent Robe of the Thespian
rows.description: Disguises the presence of armor as normal clothing.; +2 to overcome spell resistance

rows.name: Robe of Components
rows.description: Pockets contain all necessary spell components up to 50 gp.

rows.name: Robe of Gates
rows.description: When casting a summoning spell for a variable number of creatures, wearer can choose to summon maximum number 3/day.

rows.name: Robe of Infinite Twine
rows.description: The wearer can draw up to 30 feet of twine or up to 10 feet of hemp rope per round from the robe without harming it.

rows.name: Shocking Robe

rows.name: Smuggler's Collapsible Robe

rows.name: Quick Runner's Shirt
rows.description: Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can take an additional move action to move on his turn.

rows.name: Resplendent Uniform Coat
rows.description: A cavalier with the tactician ability may use that ability one additional time per day, and his tactician ability affects allies within 60 feet instead of 30 feet.

rows.name: Shirt of Immolation
rows.description: Deals 1d6+10 fire damage to a grappling creature up to 10 rounds per day.

rows.name: Tunic of Careful Casting
rows.description: +2 Concentration

rows.name: Deathwatch Eyes
rows.description: Wearer gains constant effects of the Deathwatch spell.

rows.name: Sea Tyrant's Patch
rows.description: Always subject to Touch of the Sea and Water Breathing

rows.name: Sniper Goggles (Greater)
rows.description: Wearer can make ranged sneak attacks from any distance with a +2 circumstance bonus on each sneak attack damage die.

rows.name: Spectacles of Understanding

rows.name: Truesight Goggles

rows.name: Acrobat Slippers
rows.description: Wearer retains Dex bonus when climbing, running or to avoid falling.

rows.description: Wearer always takes minimum damage from falls.

rows.description: +2 AC when attempting Overrun

rows.description: +10 AC vs Traps

rows.description: Melee attacks deal 1d6 points of acid damage

rows.name: Medusa Mask
rows.description: The mask grants protection against visual effects, including gaze attacks and sight-based illusions.; Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cause the central gemstone to glow with pale green light, at which point she may target any one creature within 30 feet. The targeted creature must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or be petrified for 1 minute, as if by flesh to stone.

rows.name: Headband of Mental Resilience
rows.description: Wearer gains 5 temporary ability points. Any damage or drain to a mental ability score taken by the wearer is subtracted from these points first.

rows.description: This amulet, usually crafted from the splintered remains of spent firearm bullets shaped into a rough holy symbol or clover, grants the wearer a luck bonus to AC against firearm attacks that target touch AC.

rows.name: Armbands of the Brawler
rows.description: These scarred and worn armbands have clearly seen rough use, and are constructed out of coarse leather and fastened with thick leather straps. They grant their wearer a +1 competence bonus on grapple checks and checks to break a grapple.

rows.name: Arrowmaster's Bracers
rows.description: Damage reduction 5/magic against ranged weapons, +1 deflection bonus against ranged attacks.

rows.name: Bracers of Falcon's Aim
rows.description: They continually grant the wearer the benefits of the aspect of the falcon spell, though without the spell's physical transformation.

rows.name: Duelist's Vambraces
rows.description: once per round, when attacking with an off-handed weapon, the wearer can reduce any penalties on attack rolls made with that weapon by 2

rows.name: Vambraces of Defense
rows.description: Once per day, as an immediate action, if the wearer has at least one hand free, when he would normally be hit with an attack from a ranged weapon, he may deflect it with the bracers, taking no damage from it, as if he had the Deflect Arrows feat.

rows.name: Dry Load Powder Horn
rows.description: This magical powder horn holds 20 doses of black powder. Furthermore, when a firearm is loaded with black powder directly from this horn, the horn creates a small pocket of air that envelops the gun and allows that shot to be fired underwater or in an area lacking air, such as a vacuum. Once the gun is loaded with powder from the dry load powder horn, it retains the pocket of air for 10 minutes or until the firearm is fired, whichever comes first. Firing a firearm that has been loaded from this horn underwater still incurs the -2 penalty on attack rolls for every 5 feet of water the bullet passes through, in addition to the normal penalties to range. When a shot loaded from a dry load powder horn results in a firearm explosion while underwater or in an airless environment, that explosion occurs normally.

rows.name: Far-Reaching Sight
rows.description: This sight can be attached to a single two-handed firearm. When this is done, the sight becomes part of the weapon, but can be removed from that weapon with a full-round action. A firearm wielder can choose to spend a full-round action to make a single shot with a firearm that has this sight. When she does, she can resolve the attack against the touch AC of her target regardless of the range increment.

rows.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Slate Spider)
rows.description: This figure of wondrous power uses the same general rules for all magic items of this type (Core Rulebook 513). This statuette of a spider with stubby legs can be used once per day for 1 minute. When activated, the figurine spouts longer, segmented legs, and scampers about the activator, picking lint off robes, chiseling grime from armor, or otherwise grooming its activator. If commanded to do so as a free action, it perches on the muzzle of a one-handed or two-handed firearm barrel and, after the firearm is fired, travels down the barrel and cleans out the firearm. Each time the slate spider cleans a firearm, the next shot the firearm fires has no chance of misfiring. When animated, a slate spider has 1 hit point and is considered an attended object. An animated slate spider will never willingly leave space of its animator.

rows.name: Oil (Of Silence)
rows.description: When applied to a one-handed or two-handed firearm, this strange grayish oil renders that firearm silent for 1 hour. Five vials of oil of silence can be used in conjunction to silence a Large firearm siege engine, and 10 can be used to silence a Huge firearm siege engine. The oil does not work on firearm siege engines that are larger than Huge.

rows.name: Orb of Foul Abaddon
rows.description: +1 caster level to spells with evil descriptor

rows.name: Orb of Golden Heaven
rows.description: Making a melee touch attack with the orb has the same effect as dousing the target with a flask of holy water.

rows.name: Orb of Utter Chaos
rows.description: Three times per day, when the bearer holds the orb and casts a spell with the polymorph subtype, chaotic descriptor, or one that gives creatures the confused condition, she may modify her caster level for that spell by 1d62.

rows.name: Pipes of Dissolution
rows.description: Creatures within 30 feet gain a +2 competence bonus on caster level checks to dispel magical effects and overcome spell resistance.

rows.name: Pipes of Pain
rows.description: With a DC 15 Perform (wind instruments) check, the bearer can fascinate creatures within 30 feet for as long as the bearer continues to play (Will DC 14 negates). When the bearer stops playing, for the next 2d4 rounds all creatures who were fascinated are stricken by intense pain taking 1d4 points of damage per round, and have sonic vulnerability.

rows.name: Polymorphic Pouch
rows.description: If bearer transforms, the pouch automatically relocates to an easily accessible location, allowing access to the items within.

rows.name: Prayer Wheel of Ethical Strength (Sacred)
rows.description: Once attuned, the bearer's ki strikes count as good.

rows.name: Prayer Wheel of Ethical Strength (Profane)
rows.description: Once attuned, the bearer's ki strikes count as evil.

rows.name: Steadfast Gut-Stone
rows.description: Any time an attack would subject the bearer to precision-based damage (critical hit or sneak attack), the damage is instead directed to the gut-stone. 10 HP and hardness 0.

rows.description: Stores up to 500 levels of spells.

rows.name: Void Dust
rows.description: If sprinkled on or thrown at a force effect, it acts as a Dispel Magic, unless the force effect is immune, in which case it acts like Disintegrate.

rows.name: Void Pennant
rows.description: Any creature that teleports into or out of an area 30 ft in diameter around the pennant is nauseated for 1 round (DC 18 Fort reduces to sickened).

rows.name: Volatile Vaporizer (1st)
rows.description: When placed inside a potion flask, the potion becomes a pungent 10-foot-radius cloud. Any creature within the cloud when it appears gains the full effect of the potion.
